commits.subject: Set USE_TYPO_METRICS, as the release has
commits.body: The release sets fsSelection bit 7 (USE_TYPO_METRICS); it was built with sfdLib 2.0.0, which sets it whenever OS2_UseTypoMetrics is present. This file says 0.

commits.subject: Set the full name the release has
commits.body: The release was built with sfdLib 2.0.0 and ufo2ft 3.4.1, which write name ID 4 as the family and style names (Comic Relief Regular); FontForge exports FullName, which this file states as Comic Relief.

flags_reason: --fontforge-notdef dropped: the release was built with sfdLib 2.0.0 and a UFO compiler, not exported by FontForge, and its .notdef is not FontForge's rectangle (research-scratch sfd-reland-notdef/notdef_census.py).
